name: mischief
description: Chaos for your detection: during working hours, briefly stops allow-listed services, kills allow-listed processes and opens decoy ports, always puts things back, and keeps a ledger to score what your team caught.

services.about: systemd units it MAY stop (space-separated). Nothing else is ever touched; there's no default, so you choose the blast radius

processes.about: process names it may kill (should be supervised, so they come back), space-separated

ports.about: range for decoy listening ports (opened, held, closed)

window.about: local hours it may act in (START-END), so people are around to notice and respond

hold.about: seconds each prank lasts before it's undone

chance.about: percent chance of a prank at each roll (every 30 minutes)
